thread:
Marta: Quick sync — need to lock scope for the Optimize Toolkit slice we promised next sprint. Core asks: batching heuristics, prefix/KV caching guidance, quantization recommendations (coarse -> automated later), and eval-triggered alerts tied to customer prompt sets. Customers: Acme & Finch want per-route recs + alerting. Proposal below.

Devon: Sounds good. Plan: 1) recommend batching & cache config API + heuristics rules; 2) a 'recommendation' endpoint returning recs with rationale & confidence; 3) eval-alert webhook. Quant profiling for quant recs will be v1 coarse (model family + perf profile) — full auto-quant later.

Cheng: Infra notes: batching increases peak GPU mem. Need max_batch_size per route, and safe fallbacks to smaller batch if mem high. Also require a sampling profiler for model shapes.

Lia: From customer-side: they want ability to pin model variant when applying quant recs and an explanation string to send to security/compliance teams.

Sam: SRE: define SLOs. Must ensure p95 latency doesn't degrade >20% with batching on user-sensitive routes. Rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with auto-fallback on error rate spike. Add a toggle per-org.

Marta: Acceptance criteria (v1):
- Recommend API returns batching/cache/quant recs with confidence and rationale.
- Recommend API has per-route scope and per-org opt-out.
- Eval-alert rules can be attached to prompt sets and fire to webhook/email.
- Runbook + migration checklist published.
- Canary rollout & rollback hooks implemented.

Marta: Example eval-alert payload for Ops:
```json
{
  "alert_id": "eval:promptset:finch-123",
  "severity": "warning",
  "metric": "response_concordance",
  "threshold": 0.65,
  "window": "1h",
  "samples": 120
}
```

Devon: For quant recs we should include a 'suggested_quant' field with values like "fp16", "int8-ggml" and a 'quality_delta_est' e.g. "-0.4%". We can populate with model family heuristics.

Lia: Docs: add how-to for pinning variants, how to test quant locally, and a support playbook for customer opt-outs.

Cheng: Action items: @Devon owner for recs API, @Cheng infra for profiler & per-route caps, @Lia docs & cust comms, @Sam rollout runbook. Ops-bot will create ticket.

ops-bot: Created ticket RK-4821: "Optimize-toolkit v1 - recs API + eval-alerts" :ticket:.

Marta: OK. Can we get sign-off by tomorrow EOD? :eyes: 

Devon: Working on a short PR draft today. :thumbsup: 

Sam: I'll draft SLO language and rollback thresholds.

Lia: I'll draft the customer-facing one-pager and migration checklist.

Marta: Thanks — we'll reconvene in the sync tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
